lessons.title: Introduction to Machine Learning
lessons.description: Learn the fundamentals of machine learning algorithms, including supervised and unsupervised learning techniques.
lessons.overview: This lesson provides a comprehensive introduction to machine learning, covering fundamental concepts, algorithms, and practical applications. Students will gain hands-on experience with supervised and unsupervised learning techniques.
learningObjectives: Understand the basic concepts and terminology of machine learning
Differentiate between supervised and unsupervised learning
Implement basic machine learning algorithms
Evaluate model performance using appropriate metrics

lessons.title: Neural Networks Deep Dive
lessons.description: Explore the architecture and training of neural networks, from basic perceptrons to deep learning models.
lessons.overview: Dive deep into neural network architectures, understanding how they learn and process information. This lesson covers everything from single-layer perceptrons to complex deep learning models.
learningObjectives: Understand neural network architecture and components
Learn about activation functions and their roles
Master backpropagation algorithm
Build and train deep neural networks

lessons.title: Natural Language Processing Basics
lessons.description: Introduction to NLP concepts including tokenization, embeddings, and transformer models.
lessons.overview: Learn the fundamentals of natural language processing, from basic text preprocessing to advanced transformer models. This lesson covers practical NLP techniques used in modern AI applications.
learningObjectives: Understand text preprocessing and tokenization
Learn about word embeddings and vector representations
Explore transformer architecture
Apply NLP techniques to real-world problems

lessons.title: AI Ethics and Bias
lessons.description: Examine ethical considerations in AI development, including algorithmic bias, fairness, and accountability.
lessons.overview: Explore the ethical dimensions of artificial intelligence, focusing on bias, fairness, and responsible AI development. This lesson addresses critical questions about how AI systems should be designed and deployed.
learningObjectives: Identify sources of bias in AI systems
Understand fairness metrics and evaluation methods
Learn about ethical frameworks for AI development
Develop strategies for building responsible AI systems

lessons.title: Privacy and Data Protection
lessons.description: Understanding privacy concerns in AI systems and strategies for protecting user data.
lessons.overview: Learn about privacy challenges in AI systems and explore techniques for protecting sensitive data while maintaining model performance. This lesson covers legal, technical, and ethical aspects of data privacy.
learningObjectives: Understand privacy risks in AI systems
Learn about differential privacy and federated learning
Explore data protection regulations
Implement privacy-preserving techniques

lessons.title: AI in Society: Impacts and Challenges
lessons.description: Explore how AI technologies affect society, including job displacement, decision-making, and social dynamics.
lessons.overview: Examine the broader societal impacts of AI technologies, from economic effects to social and cultural changes. This lesson encourages critical thinking about AI's role in shaping our future.
learningObjectives: Analyze economic impacts of AI automation
Understand AI's role in decision-making systems
Explore social and cultural implications
Develop informed perspectives on AI governance

lessons.title: Building Your AI Portfolio
lessons.description: Learn how to showcase your AI projects effectively and build a compelling portfolio for job applications.
lessons.overview: Master the art of creating an impressive AI portfolio that stands out to employers. This lesson covers project selection, documentation, presentation, and portfolio platforms.
learningObjectives: Select and prioritize projects for your portfolio
Create compelling project documentation
Present technical work to non-technical audiences
Build and maintain an online portfolio

lessons.title: AI Career Paths and Opportunities
lessons.description: Discover various career paths in AI, from research to industry applications, and how to prepare for them.
lessons.overview: Explore the diverse career opportunities in artificial intelligence, from research positions to industry roles. Learn about required skills, educational paths, and how to position yourself for success.
learningObjectives: Identify different AI career paths
Understand required skills and qualifications
Learn about educational and training options
Develop a career action plan

lessons.title: Networking in the AI Community
lessons.description: Strategies for connecting with professionals, attending conferences, and building relationships in the AI field.
lessons.overview: Learn effective networking strategies specific to the AI community. This lesson covers online and offline networking, conference participation, and building meaningful professional relationships.
learningObjectives: Develop effective networking strategies
Navigate AI conferences and events
Build and maintain professional relationships
Leverage social media for networking
